system.description:
Your conduct or moods are modified. This may be due to conditioning and reprogramming via time-accelerated psychosurgery, drugs, genetic tweaks, psi, or other factors. 

This may have been a deliberate choice or it may have been inflicted against your will. Work with your GM to define a specific emotion (e.g., sadness, anxiety, anger, inhibitions) or behavior (e.g., aggression, stealing, eating, lying, using a specific drug). Apply a –10 modifier per level to all actions when the behavior/emotion is not avoided.

Level 3: You are incapable of pursuing the behavior; emotions are expunged. If forced to engage in the conduct or to experience the emotion, suffer SV 1d6.

This trait may be taken more than once for different behaviors.
